appName: WCAG & ADA Accessibility Checker for Confluence
tagline: Find and fix WCAG 2.2 failures across your Confluence pages, and publish the conformance report an auditor will accept
summary: Check every page against WCAG 2.2, fix issues in place, and publish the conformance report your auditor asks for.

highlights.title: See problems where the writing happens
highlights.description: Every page carries a score in its byline. Each finding explains what a reader loses and how to fix it, and alt text can be written straight into the page from the panel.
highlights.caption: The check panel open on a page, showing the measured contrast ratio and the field that writes alt text back into the page.

highlights.title: Report against the standard, not a score
highlights.description: A conformance table by WCAG success criterion, with criteria that need human judgement marked for review rather than claimed either way. Publish it as a dated Confluence page.
highlights.caption: Conformance by success criterion across a space, with the number of pages affected by each.

highlights.title: Fix the pattern, not the page
highlights.description: Findings ranked by severity across the whole space, so four hundred pages missing alt text become one campaign instead of four hundred separate tasks.
highlights.caption: Findings by check across a scanned space, ordered by severity and showing how many pages each one affects.
